title: Bug Bounty Triage, Contained
outro: Triage the real ones. Skip the noise.
script: A bug bounty report is the most hostile text you'll ever paste into an AI agent. It's written by strangers, about your security — and sometimes written to attack the agent itself. IronClaw treats it that way. Prompt-injection scanning guards the seams where text could become instructions — routines, memory, tool catalogs — and a leak detector scrubs known credential shapes — API keys, private keys, tokens — from command output before the model sees it. Then comes reproduction — not on your laptop. The agent works in an isolated sandbox with hard memory and execution caps, following a security review playbook, and every confirmed finding ships with a concrete fix, not just a severity label. Then it labels the issue and posts the verdict. Triage the real ones. Skip the noise.
